prompt: Design the technical architecture and pick a tech stack for my app.
assertions: Recognizes that no capability breakdown was provided
Tries to retrieve the breakdown via the librarian skill, or asks the user to provide it
Does NOT fabricate a full architecture for an unspecified app without any capability basis
Asks a small number of targeted questions (not an exhaustive questionnaire)
If it asks constraint questions, they focus on high-leverage items (scale, team, hosting, compliance)
Suggests running the solution-architect skill first if no breakdown exists
Does NOT attempt to persist/save output
Behavior reflects 'build on the breakdown' principle rather than guessing the whole system
